arguments.name: Audio student AP against independent content-color events
arguments.description: Tie-correct event AP from ranked chromatic peaks with.2s NMS and one-to-one±.2s matching to independent human content events; average paired seeds within canonical family then macro-family mean. Same source support across all arms and controls; no-event AP undefined, false-cue/minute and coverage mandatory. Conditional historicalDEV pilot, not teacher-observer AP or human preference.
arguments.noise_note: No noise sigma or powered MDE measured at registration; no numeric noise floor is assumed.
